output.reason: The proposals cited only the one-line changelog entry [ev-0a972c483827] and missed the linked issue and PR. Issue #5715 says client-go writes its logs through klog in a glog-style format, while Argo CD's own logs use logfmt or json, so the log output is inconsistent and hard to parse; it asks for one consistent structured format [ev-162418936955][ev-1834fff30cbf]. PR #21458 fixes that issue by sending klog output through Argo CD's log format setting, and its test shows `ARGOCD_LOG_FORMAT=json` producing JSON log lines [ev-131b8e80f685][ev-29ac0e5dfdfa]. The changed files (cmd/main.go, util/log/logrus.go) fit that reading [ev-a4811186caba]. Together this names the subject (klog/client-go log output and the log format setting, ARGOCD_LOG_FORMAT), the change (klog lines now follow the configured logfmt/json format instead of glog style), who is exposed (components that emit client-go/klog logs) and the consequence (those log lines change format with no operator action, which affects anyone parsing them), so an engineer could write the typed assertion.
